Host runtime — the driver topology of the cans host.

Issue #69 fixture artifact: a plain-text diagram under the workspace, the
class of file the cans layout breeds beside the specs (field layouts,
schemas, wire formats, pipeline diagrams, example code) and the class the
reporter's source tree points at. It is a WORKSPACE file, never a spec
(discovery takes root-level .md and index.md only) and never scanned by the
codebase phase (everything inside cans/ is always skipped); the text-heading
vocabulary (issue #60) makes its underlined section lines addressable
anchors, which is what the src/ pointers below rely on.

driver-avf
----------
  host pci ----> avf ----> vm[0].net0

driver-virtio
-------------
  host mmio --> virtio-pci --> vm[1].net0

The driver backend tree (issue #70 extension): the pluggable implementations
the DriverRouter mediates, mirroring the real diagram's kelir-drivers box.
The tree tokens below are the leaf vocabulary the src/ pointers ride —
box-drawn tree lines, never headings (the parens and the lowercase names
keep the text-heading vocabulary exactly as #69 pinned it).

│  ├── driver-rustvmm (DEFAULT Linux, Rust VMM)
│  ├── driver-avf     (Intel AVF passthrough)
│  └── driver-cloud-hypervisor (fallback)
